question: Should this PR establish medium-weight tokens as the default policy for non-prominent iOS controls after the audit parser and native i18n blockers are fixed?
rationale: The parser and i18n failures are mechanical, but the branch also changes visible iOS hierarchy and scoped repository guidance, which automation should not accept as product direction without owner intent.

options.title: Accept Policy After Blockers
options.body: Fix the parser and i18n inventory, then merge after iOS owner review if medium-weight hierarchy is the intended design direction.

options.title: Limit To Targeted Polish
options.body: Keep only the local token demotions and tests, and remove or narrow the AGENTS.md and DESIGN.md policy additions.

options.title: Hold For Design Review
options.body: Pause until an iOS design owner provides the preferred hierarchy and visual acceptance target.

recommendation.title: Accept Policy After Blockers
recommendation.body: Fix the parser and i18n inventory, then merge after iOS owner review if medium-weight hierarchy is the intended design direction.

likelyOwner.reason: joshavant has the strongest recent history across the edited manual gateway picker, iOS typography tests, typography guidance, and native i18n inventory.
